newsitem.title: USA: CNB '97 management pay geared to $2.51 EPS.
newsitem.headline: CNB '97 management pay geared to $2.51 EPS.

text.p: CNB Bancshares Inc chief financial officer John Spruill said Tuesday management compensation is geared toward meeting earnings of $2.51 a share in 1997, above analysts estimates of $2.38 a share.
"For most of us to have access to the same payout in '97 that we had in '96, we have to earn $2.51," he said at a Howe Barnes Investments Inc conference here.
Spruill said the bank is "officially comfortable" with analysts' estimates calling for earnings of $2.38 a share, up from $2.12 a year ago.
"We have management meetings, we talk about what the analysts think, we talk about the budget and then we talk about $2.51," Spruill said.
Shares of the $4.1 billion asset, Evansville, Indiana-based bank holding company were unchanged at 37-7/8 Tuesday.
